desktop.setup: test ! -e ~/.actions-runners/eclipse/paused && set -a && . ~/.actions-runners/eclipse/.env && set +a && export PATH=$(cat ~/.actions-runners/eclipse/.path) && eval "$(vscreen env)"
desktop.note: ludodesktop, the maintainer's own machine: only while nobody uses it (tools/ci/runner_pause.py: screen locked or untouched for 15 min, no game; a paused desktop refuses workers and stops the running ones, whose harnesses then run here); 8 jobs at most, in the CI runner's environment and slice

local_only.save_roundtrip: runs the game on a virtual screen (vscreen) with a null ALSA device, or offscreen in the logged-in macOS session

solo.remote_fireball: two game windows (lan_e2e); on 4 CPUs beside other harnesses, screenshots and control requests take ticks the check needs
solo.remote_fireworks: two game windows (lan_e2e); a screenshot took ~1.5 s beside 3 other harnesses on a 4-CPU runner, past the sparks' life (2026-10-27)
solo.return_to_sender: a game window: an attack on a fireball and its flight to the ghast take ticks the check needs
solo.server_player_sculk: two game windows (lan_e2e); failed on a 4-CPU runner beside other harnesses, passes alone (2026-10-27)
solo.world_reopen: a game window reopening a world: failed on a 4-CPU runner beside other harnesses (2026-10-27)
solo.wire_stream: a vanilla client, a vanilla server and a Eclipse client: a loaded runner delays logins past their limits

named_only.frame_identity: fails any change that moves the picture on purpose; a pull request that must leave it alone (HDR, shader packs) carries the frame-identity label, or run it by name
named_only.lan_integration: the whole lan_e2e suite: ~40 min a run on a loaded runner, and single checks flake under load; run it by name, or tools/lan_e2e.py
named_only.wire_stream: a real vanilla 26.3 client on a virtual screen beside a vanilla server and a headless Eclipse client, ~15 min a run; run it by name (before a pull request that changes what the client sends) or nightly

known_flaky.world_reopen: counted 4 minecarts instead of 3 once on a loaded Mac mini runner, then passed at the same head (10-26)
known_flaky.lunge_motion: a loaded Mac mini runner: the server catches up with two ticks for one of the jump's moves (Alice falls a tick of gravity more, -0.3015 vs -0.2277; the harness now names it), and vanilla's own run once sent an extra motion while sprinting; the same trees pass alone (#5656, 11-01)
